Your project builds itself.

## Download

- **galleryLAB-setup.exe** installs galleryLAB for your Windows account, over an existing copy in the same
  folder. If you have 0.1.1 or later, galleryLAB installs this update by itself.
- **galleryLAB-portable.exe** runs without installing and replaces itself when a new version comes out.

Requires Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Windows SmartScreen may say the build isn't recognised; choose **More
info**, then **Run anyway**.

## What's new

- **Automatic build.** Once an import settles, galleryLAB reads every photo (palette, tone, warmth, texture,
  structure, shape), picks one of six exhibition archetypes for the collection and writes its theme. The
  project screen shows a progress bar with the current stage, and you can pause, resume, cancel or build
  again. The Library card says "Building 40%" while it runs.
- **Generated assets from your own images.** Choose a generator in Settings (Stability AI, OpenAI or xAI
  Grok), paste your API key, and each build makes new images seeded by your collection's colours and mood.
  Set how many images per build and a spend cap; the estimated cost shows before anything is spent. Keys are
  stored encrypted on this PC and never written into a project.
- **Generated strip.** New images appear under the contact sheet as they arrive.
